purpose: Machine-prove that every current-race feature used for an EARLY/LATE prediction was available no later than that prediction snapshot.
rules: feature_source_time_jst must parse as an offset-aware timestamp and be <= prediction_snapshot_time_jst.
Each race_id/horse_no/snapshot_role/feature_name must resolve to exactly one frozen value.
source_file_sha256 must be a 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256.
Post-race/outcome fields are forbidden as prediction features regardless of timestamp.
Current-race features may not be sourced from the final/post-race parsed JVD dataset.
No later cancellation/exclusion/bodyweight/track/weather state may be backfilled into an earlier snapshot.
pass_condition: Zero violations across all rows and exact input SHA archived before model execution.
